summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, charged with the murder of Timothy Confoy, was released on $5,000 bond in Judge Klein's court; Thomas J. Rowe of 619 Market Street went his bond.

metadata.notes: No page image, so the masthead and date could not be checked. May 4, 1899 was a Thursday, which fits 'Thursday morning' in an evening paper.
